description: June 25 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 1, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a June 25 birthday falls in Cancer, in the first decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: Personality of a June 25 birthday
paragraphs: Look past the shell. The 25th of June combines early Cancer, about three degrees in, with 7, the most private of numbers. The Moon-ruled first decan heightens intuition, so this birthday is traditionally pictured as perceptive, reflective and slow to trust, a person whose inner life is rich and who shares it with very few people.

By noon UTC on June 25, the Sun has normally reached roughly 3° of Cancer. That places the date in the Cancer decan that astrologers give to Moon, the first of three. The Moon rules Cancer and also presides over its first decan, so roughly June 22 to July 1 is traditionally the most lunar part of the year. Feeling comes first here, often before words. Natives of this decan are frequently portrayed as protective, intuitive and deeply attached to home, family and memory. Their moods may rise and fall like tides, which is less a flaw than a rhythm worth learning. A doubled Moon can also mean holding on to old hurts longer than they deserve. Giving care to themselves as freely as they give it to everyone else is often the central lesson.

sections.heading: Numerology of the June 25 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 25th, your compound 2 + 5 reduces to 7. The 2's intuition and the 5's curiosity come together in the 7's reflective, analytical temperament. People born on the 25th are frequently described as perceptive, observant and drawn to understanding how things and people really work. They may test ideas through experience before trusting them. In its secondary role, the 25 is traditionally linked with a strong inner voice and a need for quiet time to process what they have gathered. Their insight often becomes valuable to others once they decide to share it.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same June 25 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 22 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: June 25 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 25 is the 176th day of the year (177th in a leap year). In most years Leo season is under way by July 23, 28 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a June 25 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. June 25 is also the birthday of George Orwell (1903), Antoni Gaudí (1852) and George Michael (1963).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 25?
faq.answer: June 25 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 25?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 25 the Life Path is 2 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 22 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 25th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 25?
faq.answer: By June 25 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 25?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a June 25 birthday are George Orwell (1903), Antoni Gaudí (1852) and George Michael (1963). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
